title: Smoked Vegan Kebabs
description: A flavorful and smoky kebab recipe made with marinated tofu and vegetables, perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the pressed tofu, sliced bell peppers, red onion, and zucchini to the marinade.
Mix well to coat and let it sit for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated vegetables and tofu onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and slightly charred.
Serve the kebabs over a bed of cooked bulgur.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
Enjoy your delicious Smoked Vegan Kebabs!
